name: LLM setup (app.tab.ready)
description: First-run setup, once, on the first UI tab that finishes loading after install: makes sure there is an LLM source (`flow llm set auto`), then runs this wizard — jq, ripgrep, Claude Code, Python 3, Git and Node.js, asking before installing any that is missing. fire_once: it never runs on its own again — Settings → General → Run setup again runs the same two steps on demand.
